subject: Ringscope - MSA & Order Form: publicity and confidentiality
messages:
From: Aaron Mills <aaron@ringscope.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie@ringscope.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ringscope - MSA/Order Form: publicity & confidentiality language

Grace —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call today. As we move to sign the MSA and Order Form I attached our initial redlines focused on two items where we need clarity before countersigning: (1) publicity/reference rights (case studies, press release language, logo use) and (2) confidentiality carveouts for shared performance metrics.

High level asks from Ringscope:
- We would like the ability to issue a joint press release and reference Redwood on our customer page; need to confirm whether that includes a logo file and which assets (SVG vs raster).
- We need a 30-day embargo window for public announcements from signature, and one-week advance review of any marketing copy that uses our name or quotes.
- Any publicity language must exclude customer PII and product telemetry that could be considered confidential.
- On confidentiality: require a carveout to share aggregated success metrics with our board and auditors; we can accept aggregated numbers but need a recordkeeping/audit trail assurance.

I attached: Ringscope_Redlines_v1.docx (our proposed MSA/Order Form redlines) and OrderForm_Ringscope.pdf (signed copy pending countersign). Can you route to your legal team and let us know redline/approval timeline? We need to finalize before next Wednesday if possible — ringscope is scheduling a press slot for May 10.

Appreciate it —
Aaron Mills
Head of Partnerships
Ringscope, Inc.

Attachments: Ringscope_Redlines_v1.docx, OrderForm_Ringscope.pdf

Proposed action plan from our side:
1) Rishi to provide prioritized redline responses and a short alternate clause set for publicity that narrows scope.
2) We will confirm the logo asset types we provide (official SVG + PNG variants) and a short usage guide.
3) If an embargo is required we'll try to align on 30 days from signature; Redwood prefers 14 days in standard templates but open to 30 for strategic launches.
4) We can accept an auditor-friendly carveout for aggregated metrics with a requirement that any shared metrics are non-identifying and accompanied by a written attestation.

Ben, please note Ringscope is asking for May 10 press slot — can we meet a review/countersign by EOD next Tuesday (26th) to make that possible?

I'll follow up after Rishi's initial pass.

Thanks,

Team — I reviewed Ringscope_Redlines_v1.docx and drafted a Redwood redline with targeted alternatives. Key points below (redline attached): Redwood_MSA_redline_Ringscope.docx, publicity_guidance.pdf

1) Publicity / Reference Rights
- Narrow the "publicity" permission: Redwood requests the ability to name Ringscope as a customer and publish non-confidential summaries and a short case study (<= 300 words) with customer approval.
- Logo use: approve use of official logo assets only (we will provide SVG + 2 PNG sizes). Any modification or co-brand placement requires prior written approval.
- Embargo: propose a 21-day embargo from countersignature. Accept 30 days only if Ringscope confirms the May 10 slot is firm and provides a signed Order Form by 26 April.
- Quote approvals: require ringscope to provide approvals on quotes within 5 business days; automatic use only if no response after 5 days with a single reminder.

2) Confidentiality / Metrics carveout
- Agreed to a limited carveout for aggregated, non-identifying success metrics to be shared with Ringscope board/auditors provided (i) data is aggregated across customers or anonymized, and (ii) Redwood maintains an audit log of disclosures for compliance.
- Add a clause that telemetry/usage logs that contain customer-identifying keys are excluded from publicity permissions.

3) Escrow & Auditability
- Offer to provide a short attestation and summary of SOC 2 controls upon request and execution of an NDA addendum for auditor access.

Rishi suggested fallback language for each contested paragraph in the redline document. If Ringscope can sign the Order Form (or return countersigned PDF) by EOD 26 Apr, we can meet a May 10 announcement with the 30-day embargo; otherwise we recommend 21 days to keep momentum.

Next steps: please review attached redline and confirm which items are deal-blockers for Ringscope.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
